    "00:00.000–00:00.250 — Handheld glass container: at least 5 green olives visible; fingers and overlapping fruit prevent a complete count.",
    "00:00.500–00:01.250 — First pour into the large jar: olives visibly fall from the handheld container; at 00:01.000 at least 3 green olives are distinguishable near the bottom, and at 00:01.250 at least 4 olives are distinguishable there. Moving olives are blurred, so exact intermediate totals are unresolved.",
    "00:01.500–00:02.250 — First pour continues. At 00:01.750 and 00:02.000 at least 12 green and dark olives are distinguishable in the receiving jar. Additions have a visible cause: olives entering through its mouth.",
    "00:02.500–00:02.750 — Further olives visibly fall into the receiving jar, building a deeper overlapping pile; exact inventory is obscured.",
    "00:03.000, 00:03.250, 00:03.500, 00:03.750, 00:04.000, 00:04.250, 00:04.500, 00:04.750, 00:05.000, 00:05.250, 00:05.500, 00:05.750 — Receiving jar: at least 18 distinguishable olives; the settled arrangement remains stable between pours. Rear olives are concealed by the front layer.",
    "00:03.000–00:04.250 — Handheld container retains partly obscured green olives after the first pour; a complete remaining count cannot be established.",
    "00:00.000–00:04.250 — Rear metal bowl: at least 7 olives visible above its rim, with a stable arrangement; the rim conceals additional contents.",
    "00:04.500–00:05.250 — The person reaches into the rear bowl and lifts a loaded glass container from it. The exposed olive count decreases during this visible handling; hands and the container obscure the exact number transferred.",
    "00:05.250–00:09.750 — Rear metal bowl: remaining contents are initially partly hidden by the rim; later views distinguish at least 3 green olives and 1 brown olive among small food pieces. No subsequent handling or confirmed spontaneous count change.",
    "00:05.250–00:06.250 — Handheld container is loaded again; at least 6 green olives are distinguishable at 00:06.250, with other contents concealed by fingers and overlap.",
    "00:06.000–00:06.250 — Receiving jar: same settled pile; the bottom becomes cropped, preventing a complete visible count.",
    "00:06.500–00:08.500 — Second pour: green and dark olives visibly leave the handheld container and enter the receiving jar. The pile rises through these additions; blur, overlap, and bottom cropping prevent exact intermediate totals.",
    "00:08.750–00:09.750 — Receiving jar settles after the second pour; at 00:09.500 and 00:09.750 at least 28 olives are distinguishable, with more potentially concealed behind them. No confirmed loss or spontaneous addition after pouring stops.",
